fields.label: Company Name
fields.description: The customer's entity name. buildPortalRequestPayload has always sent this and the admin inbox has always rendered it, but the field did not exist — so it was silently dropped on write and the column read as an empty dash.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
New
Waiting on Admin
Waiting on User
Resolved

fields.label: Last Message At
fields.description: Server-stamped on every message from either side; drives inbox ordering and both unread badges.

fields.label: User Last Read At
fields.description: Stamped when the customer opens the thread; compared against last_message_at for the customer's badge.

fields.label: Last Admin Seen At
fields.description: Stamped when staff open the thread in the admin inbox; compared against last_message_at for the staff badge. Existed on this doctype from the start but nothing ever wrote to it.
